title: Mexican Street Corn Grilled Chicken
description: A flavorful and colorful dish that combines the smokiness of grilled chicken with the sweetness of corn, all seasoned with vibrant and spicy Mexican flavors.

ingredients.name: brine
ingredients.notes: chicken brine or substitute with kosher salt and water

ingredients.name: mexican dry blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with chili powder and cumin

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together elote seasoning, lime juice, and brine.
3. Place chicken in a large bowl and pour the marinade over it.
4. Toss chicken to coat and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
5. Grill chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
6. Grill corn for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes, or until slightly charred.
7. Once chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
8. Serve chicken with grilled corn and additional elote seasoning, if desired.
